namespace: "Convert"
description: "Reads in an H5MU file and saves it as a SpatialData Zarr store. The selected modality in the MuData is stored as the main table in the SpatialData object. If a matching existing SpatialData is provided, it will be used to fill the remaining SpatialData slots."

The selected
modality in the MuData is stored as the main table in the SpatialData object. If a matching existing SpatialData is provided, it will be used to fill the
remaining SpatialData slots.

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_h5mu_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/convert/from_h5mu_to_spatialdata);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_h5mu_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
